verdict.rationale: Bolna documents two natural-language interaction paths: Agent Studio, which turns a short natural-language description into a call-ready agent (bolna-docs-29), and an official MCP server that lets AI assistants like Claude/Cursor/Windsurf operate a Bolna account via natural-language commands (bolna-docs-17, bolna-docs-25, bolna-probe-3). These are first-party docs only, with no independent/hands-on verification of how robust or complete the natural-language command coverage is. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of MCP or Agent Studio actually executing complex commands, and clearer scope of what operations natural language can trigger beyond agent creation.
